title: Azadar
body:
Azadar
Hussain...
Hussain, Hussain, Hussain, Hussain, Hussain
Maula tum hamare, maula hum tumhare..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Maula, Maula salaam aap pe sadd baar ya hussain
sab ishq e hussaini mein hai sar shaar ya hussain
sab pe ho karam aapka sarkaar ya hussain
hazir hai, hazir hai
hazir hai azadar, azadar ya hussain
